To: d.kerrigan@northmail.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: none
Subject: Re: Blister packs for my mother - new patient

Dear Mr. Kerrigan,

Thank you for getting in touch. I’m sorry to hear about your mother’s fall, and I hope her transition home goes smoothly. We would be pleased to help Margaret with her medications.

We prepare weekly blister packs with seven days of medication, arranged for up to four times a day. There is no charge for the packaging itself; normal dispensing charges apply. Ontario Drug Benefit coverage covers most eligible prescription costs for seniors, though any applicable co-payments or charges would still be payable.

We can deliver to your mother’s building. Our regular delivery days are Tuesday and Friday, between 2 and 6 p.m., and delivery is free within 8 km. For her first packs, you can pick them up on Saturday, or we can arrange a one-time delivery before 1 p.m. that day. Please let me know which you would prefer.

To transfer her existing prescriptions, we can contact her current pharmacy for you. Please send us its name and address, along with Margaret’s OHIP number. She does not need to sign a transfer form. Please also ask the hospital discharge team to fax her discharge prescriptions to us early Thursday morning.

Our first packs generally take about 48 hours after we receive all of her prescriptions, including both the hospital prescriptions and any transfers. If we receive everything in time, we expect to have them ready Saturday. They will not be ready when she comes home on Thursday, so please confirm with the discharge team that she will have an interim supply and help with every dose until the Saturday pickup or delivery. Please let us know if there are any difficulties arranging this.

I would be happy to go over Margaret’s new medication list with you. Before we discuss her medications with you, we need her permission. We use a signed Family Communication Consent form to record her wishes and protect her privacy. She can sign it at pickup, or we can send it with the driver. Once we have her consent, we can arrange a call; I understand evenings work best for you.

I would also like to offer Margaret a MedsCheck at home during her first week back. This is an in-person medication review that takes about 20 minutes. I can visit Monday or Tuesday after 6 p.m., whichever works better for her. Please let me know if she would be interested and which evening she prefers.

You can reach me directly at 905-555-0148 ext. 2. I’m in the store Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Please feel free to call if you have any questions or would like to discuss the arrangements.

Kind regards,

Rania Haddad
Community Pharmacist
Erindale Park Pharmacy
